name: Do I need special permits to build an ADU in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: Do I need special permits to build an ADU in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, building an ADU in Orange County, including cities like Irvine or Orange, requires specific permits. These typically include planning permits, building permits, and possibly others depending on the project scope and location (e.g., grading, electrical, plumbing). Local ordinances streamline some aspects, but all projects must comply with state and local building codes, zoning regulations, and design standards.
